_comment: Canonical catalog of reusable visual primitives. This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for 'what reusable parts exist'. Each primitive is a FUNCTION (takes geometry, returns an SVG fragment) so any composition can reuse it -- never a baked template. runtime/primitives/catalog.py introspects the code against this catalog and runtime/primitives/audit.py reports drift; a primitive that is added in code but not declared here (or declared but missing) is a divergence.
return_contract: str -- a self-contained SVG fragment (no <svg> wrapper), styled from the ref_frame palette/roles
signature_contract: geometry-first positional args (x/y/w/h or cx/cy/r); optional role/color/accent last

known_gaps._comment: Tracked, not hidden. The catalog is intentionally small and grew from a 202-LOC thin layer; undiscovered parts stay visible as divergences until declared.
